---
title: "CTM Assessment"
---

One Quarto setup for text, images, Python, mathematics and JSXGraph, with shared
AI feedback. Explore partially completed tasks in the five tabs on one page.

[Try the working examples](example.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}

The page shares provider settings and configurable hint policies. Copy mode
needs no account; Direct API mode uses your own endpoint, model and personal key.
Feedback reviews current work without executing it. Check and Run remain
separate actions and reset hints by default.

[Download the installable package](ctm-assessment.tar.gz) ·
[Exact source revisions](resolved-repos.json) ·
[Authoring and installation guide](https://github.com/Erasmus-CTM/ctm-assessment)

The package contains the tested ai-feedback, math-exercise, py-exercise,
pyodide-interaktiv and JSXGraph revisions. Successful main builds automatically
publish these examples and the matching package.
